correctness.rationale: For arbitrary field K and n>=1, fixed two-sided gh multiplication induces D_{g,h}=Hom(V/im(gh-I),ker(gh-I)). Write F=ker(gh-I), U=im(gh-I) and primed variants for hg. The maps g:F’->F and gbar:V/U’->V/U are isomorphisms and agree on F’∩U’; the adapted-basis extension lemma yields Q invertible with Q|F’=g and Q−g mapping V into U. For any A in D this gives Q^-1 A Q=hAg. Intersections of elementary subspace conditions generate all B(F,U), including distinct nonzero proper F,U, proving factorization; full-domain conjugations are PGL. Pointwise stabilizers of rank-one tensors are projective transformations fixing F after scalar normalization and with (Q−I)V⊂U. In adapted decomposition the size is q^[c(u−c)+u(n−k−u+c)]|GL_(u-c)(q)|; Gaussian intersection count N_{n,k,u,c} yields the displayed sum. Independent arithmetic recomputation gives |Inn M1(F2)|=2, |Inn M2(F2)|=52, |Inn M2(F3)|=201, |Inn M3(F2)|=15506. The all-dimension extension is analytic, not concluded from finite arithmetic or saved program output.
